cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: Family-wide P7 option schemas allowed fields that a specific adapter did not consume, creating a silent-drop risk.
impact: An Agent could submit an inapplicable option and receive a successful-looking request unless each operation declared its own option boundary.
lesson: Declare and validate nested options per operation so unsupported policy fields fail closed instead of being ignored.

cause: The direct contract tool published a tuple as JSON Schema enum and tool registration failed before any Agent turn could start.
impact: All context-provider route tests failed at schema registration until the declaration projection was serialized as a JSON array.
lesson: Validate generated tool schemas through the real ToolRegistry boundary, not only by inspecting Python values.

cause: The frozen VIF engine validates a complete OLS metadata envelope even when the adapter receives only a design frame.
impact: A natural-language design-only VIF request failed closed before execution despite VIF not requiring a response model.
lesson: Adapt a design diagnostic with neutral algebraic dimensions only; never invent response, coefficient, or residual evidence.

cause: The generic workflow error surfaced only a summary and discarded the original failed step message needed for Agent recovery.
impact: A failed P7 workflow could look like an opaque generic failure and cause an Agent to repeat the same invalid proposal.
lesson: Preserve failed step IDs and original guard messages at the generic workflow seam.

cause: The direct operation-contract tool initially advertised workflow child IDs even though those IDs are valid only inside operation.multi_step.
impact: A model could spend a turn requesting a child contract against a model node and receive a rejection instead of the parent workflow vocabulary.
lesson: Expose a child operation in the parent workflow vocabulary, not as an independent direct proposal or inspection target.

cause: Real Report attempts exposed a duplicate figure marker contract error and a provider ReadError; no saved report was accepted.
impact: Natural-language Report generation is not verified and must not be represented as a completed user path.
lesson: Keep provider failures and response-contract failures as visible acceptance gaps; do not replace them with unit-test evidence.

cause: P7 artifact identity omitted workflow identity, so a second workflow on one source run reused an occupied path.
impact: A user could confirm a valid repeated P7 analysis and receive a failed workflow instead of a new durable result.
lesson: Include workflow identity in deterministic P7 artifact identity while preserving same-workflow idempotency.

cause: The active-head and P7 adoption objective reached its planned verification boundary; Report provider failures remain recorded as an explicit out-of-scope gap.
impact: The formal line can be handed off locally with implementation, browser, full-gate, and known-limit evidence separated.
lesson: Complete a development line only after real-chain evidence, durable records, and the host full gate agree with the documented scope.
